#### AMEDIA-01 · تحويل نص لصوت واستنساخ وMؤثرات ElevenLabs · ElevenLabs TTS, cloning and sound effects · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يولّد كلامًا بإعدادات صوت قابلة للضبط ويستنسخ الأصوات ويحوّل الصوت ويولّد مؤثرات. — Generate speech with tunable voice settings, clone voices from samples, and produce speech-to-speech, SFX and isolation.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Building TTS, voice cloning, voice conversion, audio isolation or sound-effect generation on ElevenLabs.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Install SDK and set API key via env. 2) textToSpeech.convert(voiceId, text, model eleven_multilingual_v2, voice_settings stability ~0.5, similarity ~0.75, style, speed 0.7-1.2) and pipe stream to file. 3) Instant clone from 30+ s of clean audio. 4) Use WebSocket streaming for chatbots. 5) Cut cost by model choice, caching repeated text and usage alerts; handle 429 with queue and backoff; verify webhook HMAC. **أرقام / params:** voice id, model, voice settings
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`key:elevenlabs`](../requirements.md#req-key-elevenlabs) · [`key:unspecified`](../requirements.md#req-key-unspecified)

#### AMEDIA-02 · فحص تسليم المزيج النهائي ليوتيوب 4K · Final mix delivery check for YouTube 4K · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يصدّر ملف 4K ويتحقق من الدقة والإطارات والمدة والصوت وLUFS وذروة الصوت. — Render a 4K delivery file and verify resolution, fps, duration, AAC audio, LUFS and true peak with ffprobe and ebur128.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Preparing a DaVinci Resolve mix for upload or any final render needing loudness QA.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Duplicate timeline and keep original audio. 2) Render 3840x2160 H.264 (45 Mbps up to 30 fps, 68 at 60 fps) with AAC 48 kHz 320 kbps stereo. 3) ffprobe codec, size, fps, sample rate, channels, duration; frames within 1 of timeline. 4) ffmpeg -af ebur128=peak=true on the final file: target -14 LUFS +-1, true peak <= -1 dBTP. 5) On repeated failure stop and report; upload private by default. **أرقام / params:** loudness target
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`ffmpeg`](../requirements.md#req-ffmpeg)
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1096-akbun-editvideo/2450-davinciresolve-audio-delivery` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1096-akbun-editvideo/2459-davinciresolve-sfx-epidemicsound`
- **المصدر / source:** KOSIF Atlas mining 2026-10-20 (https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas): akbun-editvideo/davinciresolve-audio-delivery (#2450); akbun-editvideo/davinciresolve-sfx-epidemicsound (#2459) · theme audio-voice · 3 supporting skills · verifier read: skills/1096-akbun-editvideo/2450-davinciresolve-audio-delivery, skills/1096-akbun-editvideo/2459-davinciresolve-sfx-epidemicsound

#### AMEDIA-03 · مجموعات مؤثرات لعبة بمستويات صوت · Game SFX sets with loudness classes · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يولّد مجموعات مؤثرات بنسخ متعددة وفئات مستوى وتحذيرات للبدء المتأخر أو الترددات الضعيفة. — Render named effect sets with variants, level classes and warnings for late onset or inaudible lows.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** A game needs jump/coin/hit/win/UI sounds that sit together in a mix and play on phone speakers.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Pick a kit (arcade, platformer, shooter, party, ui) or write a JSON spec of effect name, preset, pitch in semitones, length, seed, style (clean/retro/soft), level. 2) Render three variants for frequent sounds, one take for once-per-round signals. 3) Normalize by loudest 50 ms into classes ui -20, small -16, normal -12, big -9 dB, ceiling -1 dBFS. 4) Reject effects that start late or have little energy under about 300 Hz. 5) Review reel spectrogram image and warnings. **أرقام / params:** kit, style, variants
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under Apache-2.0 / MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1511-homie/3901-sound` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1526-gamegen/4163-game-audio-procedural`

- **ماذا / what:** يستدعي واجهة تفريغ سحابية للنسخ والترجمة وفصل المتحدثين وتوقيت الكلمات ضمن الحدود. — Call a hosted speech-to-text API for transcription, translation, speaker diarization and word timings within size limits.

#### AMEDIA-05 · إصلاح انحراف التوقيت في دمج الصوت · Joined-audio timestamp drift fix · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يحافظ على تطابق توقيت النص والفصول بعد دمج مقاطع صوتية كثيرة. — Keep transcript, chapter and caption times aligned after concatenating many audio pieces.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Subtitles drift later through a concatenated file, joined file longer than the sum of parts, ffmpeg non-monotonic dts warning, stitching TTS chunks.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Diagnose: compare ffprobe sum of piece durations with joined duration. 2) Cause: copy-mode concat keeps each encoder's start/end padding and header frame (about 50 ms per join). 3) Frame-count arithmetic is still off, so do not rely on it. 4) Re-encode once at the end (or decode to PCM, concat, encode) so offsets are exact. 5) Verify by measuring the final file and checking last-chapter offset, never assume. **أرقام / params:** input file list, target codec
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`ffmpeg`](../requirements.md#req-ffmpeg)
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3323-joined-audio-transcript-drift/13837-joined-audio-transcript-drift`
- **المصدر / source:** KOSIF Atlas mining 2026-10-20 (https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas): joined-audio-transcript-drift/joined-audio-transcript-drift (#13837) · theme audio-voice · 3 supporting skills · verifier read: skills/3323-joined-audio-transcript-drift/13837-joined-audio-transcript-drift

#### AMEDIA-06 · تفريغ محلي بـ whisper للملفات والبث · Local whisper transcription of files and live streams · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يفرّغ الصوت أو الفيديو أو البث المباشر إلى نص بنموذج whisper محلي. — Transcribe audio, video or live streams to plain text with a local whisper model in batch or segmented live mode.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Need a transcript of a podcast, interview, live stream or video audio track and no text source exists.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Run an idempotent setup that ensures ffmpeg, yt-dlp/streamlink and a whisper runner. 2) Batch: pass file or URL (downloaded first with a time cap) and an output txt; read JSON with word count and a thin flag (under 1500 words). 3) Live: ffmpeg segments the stream into about 30 s chunks, each finished chunk is transcribed and appended to the output, stop on stream end, max minutes or Ctrl-C. 4) Run live mode in background and tail the file. Picture content is not read. **أرقام / params:** segment seconds, max minutes
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`ffmpeg`](../requirements.md#req-ffmpeg) · [`yt-dlp`](../requirements.md#req-yt-dlp) · [`pip:faster-whisper`](../requirements.md#req-pip-faster-whisper)
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/886-intel/1994-transcribe` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3214-togetherai-skills/13585-together-audio`

- **ماذا / what:** يبني بنية الأغنية ويكتب موجّهات Suno بكلمات موسومة أو خطة تأليف ElevenLabs. — Structure songs by section form and write Suno style prompts with tagged lyrics, or compose via ElevenLabs Music plans.

#### AMEDIA-09 · صوت ألعاب إجرائي بالكود · Procedural game audio from Python code · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يولّد مؤثرات وموسيقى قابلة للتكرار من كود بايثون ويصدّرها بصيغة OGG مع بيان. — Synthesize SFX and loop-ready music scores deterministically from seeds with numpy/scipy, exporting OGG plus manifest.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Need license-clean original SFX, jingles, UI sounds or looping game music without samples or paid services.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Write audio direction: cue table (id, mood, tempo, key, loop/one-shot) and SFX per game event. 2) Define a sonic identity (key, brightness, grit, space) in a shared style module. 3) Vendor the synth toolkit into the project tools dir. 4) Each SFX is a seeded function, each track a score; render via a build script writing OGG and manifest with SHA-256, duration, loop data. 5) Check objective metrics and spectrogram review images; cross-check EBU R128 with ffmpeg. Not suited to realistic acoustic instruments or vocals. **أرقام / params:** seed, key, tempo, cue list
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`ffmpeg`](../requirements.md#req-ffmpeg) · [`pip:numpy`](../requirements.md#req-pip-numpy) · [`pip:scipy`](../requirements.md#req-pip-scipy)

#### AMEDIA-10 · مقطوعة مُصنَّعة بحلقات متصلة · Synthesized score with seamless loops · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يبني مقطوعة قصيرة من ملف JSON للأوتار والأنماط ويصدّر المزيج والسطور وحلقات بلا درز. — Build a short score from a JSON of chords and patterns and render mix, stems and seamless loop sections.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Need a theme or looping bed with stems, bar grid for trailer cuts, or game music generated offline.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Write score.json: tempo, key, instruments (level, pan, echo, reverb send, kick ducking), sections in whole bars with chords and per-instrument patterns, arrangement, loop sections. 2) Render mix at -14 LUFS (or -18 as a bed under effects) plus 24-bit master and per-instrument stems that sum to the mix. 3) Loops: render each section three times and keep the middle copy so reverb tails land at the loop head. 4) Check seam value (1 or less is seamless) and bar length; export plan.json bar grid for video cuts. **أرقام / params:** --loops, --lufs
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under Apache-2.0 / MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md

#### AMEDIA-27 · Godot 4: سكربت مُنمّط وفيزياء وتصدير بلا واجهة · Godot 4: typed GDScript, physics timing, headless export · 📄 موصوف / documented only

#### AMEDIA-15 · حركة نابضية وسطح زجاجي لمواقع بمستوى Awwwards · Spring-physics motion and a layered glass surface · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يحرّك العناصر بفيزياء النابض بدلاً من منحنيات المدة، ويبني السطح الزجاجي من أربع طبقات. — Animates with spring physics instead of duration curves and composes glass from four layers.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** حركة ناعمة، أنيميشن موقع فاخر، زجاج ضبابي / spring animation, premium web motion, glassmorphism
- **كيف / how:** 1) Springs, not ease-in-out: slight overshoot (about 1.05x) then settle at 1.0, landing in 400-700 ms by travel distance (Framer Motion spring or GSAP; CSS only as fallback). 2) Glass stack bottom to top: backdrop blur 20-40 px (28 standard, 40 for modal), fill rgba(255,255,255,.05), 1 px inner border with a top-lit gradient, very soft wide ambient shadow. 3) Glass only on dark backgrounds, never with a solid fill. 4) Pair with noise, SDF and particle techniques for hero scenes. **أرقام / params:** overshoot 1.05; 400-700 ms; blur 28/40 px
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`npm:gsap`](../requirements.md#req-npm-gsap) · [`npm:animejs`](../requirements.md#req-npm-animejs)

#### AMEDIA-16 · نموذج الشيدر في React Three Fiber · GLSL shader mental model in React Three Fiber · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يشرح كيف تتكوّن المادة المخصصة من شيدر رؤوس وشيدر بكسلات، وكيف تمر البيانات عبر uniforms وvaryings. — Explains how a custom material is a vertex plus fragment program and how data flows through uniforms and varyings.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** شيدر، GLSL، تأثير ثلاثي الأبعاد على الويب / shader, GLSL, R3F custom material
- **كيف / how:** 1) Mesh = geometry + material; a shader material replaces the material with two GPU programs: the vertex shader writes gl_Position per vertex, the fragment shader writes the colour per pixel. 2) Uniforms carry JS values (time, mouse, textures) identical for all vertices; memoize the uniforms object and update values in useFrame. 3) Varyings pass data (uv, normals) from vertex to fragment. 4) Attributes are per-vertex data available only in the vertex stage. 5) Build effects from noise (Perlin, simplex, curl, FBM), SDFs and render targets for multi-pass work. **أرقام / params:** uniforms, varyings
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`npm:three`](../requirements.md#req-npm-three) · [`npm:react`](../requirements.md#req-npm-react)

#### AMEDIA-18 · حقل حراري يلطّخه الإصبع (شيدر واحد) · Thermal finger-trail field in one fragment shader · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** سطح يشبه كاميرا حرارية يسحب الإصبع ألوانه كطلاء مبلل ثم يعود، بشيدر واحد بلا قوام أو مخازن. — A heat-camera surface the pointer smears like wet paint that relaxes back, all in one fragment shader with no textures or buffers.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** تأثير حراري، تأثير لمس تفاعلي، شيدر يتبع الماوس / thermal effect, interactive smear shader, cursor trail
- **كيف / how:** 1) Field: 5-octave fbm warps the coordinates, a second fbm warps them again. 2) A soft blob breathes via two low-frequency polar sines; heat 0-1, background 0.34-0.66, capped at 0.75. 3) Colour: thermal(heat) through seven smoothstep stops at 0, .12, .30, .45, .60, .78, 1 (teal, green, yellow, orange, red). 4) JS keeps the last 24 trail points with position, velocity and age; the field is sampled from where the finger came from, so colour drags along the path. 5) Defaults: smudge 9 (above ~14 tears), radius 0.17, follow 0.3 per frame, spacing 0.01, life 1.6 s; press ring expands for 0.9 s. 6) One focal object on dark ground, no text on top, cap DPR on weak phones. **أرقام / params:** smudge 9, radius .17, follow .3, 24 points

#### AMEDIA-22 · تشخيص FFmpeg: إطار متغير، HLS متعدد الدقات، فحص التيار · FFmpeg diagnostics: VFR fix, aligned ABR HLS, stream health · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يشخّص انزياح الصوت والصورة وأخطاء الطوابع الزمنية، ويبني بث HLS بعدة دقات بإطارات مفتاحية متوافقة. — Diagnoses A/V drift and timestamp errors and builds multi-rendition HLS with aligned keyframes.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** الصوت غير متزامن، تحويل فيديو، بث HLS / audio drift, VFR video, HLS ladder, ffprobe
- **كيف / how:** 1) Inspect first: ffprobe -show_streams -of json; look for variable frame rate (screen and phone recordings), odd PTS/DTS, missing audio. 2) VFR drift: force constant frame rate (-vsync cfr / fps filter) before editing. 3) 'Non-monotonous DTS': remux with regenerated timestamps (-fflags +genpts). 4) ABR ladder: H.264 as the reach floor plus HEVC/AV1 for efficiency; renditions 1080/720/480 with identical GOP (-g 60 -keyint_min 60 -sc_threshold 0) so segments align. 5) 'Unknown encoder h264_nvenc' means the build or driver lacks NVENC; fall back to libx264. **أرقام / params:** GOP 60, renditions 1080/720/480

#### AMEDIA-23 · قص بلا فقد على الإطارات المفتاحية · Lossless keyframe-aligned cutting and smart cut · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يقص الفيديو بنسخ التيار دون إعادة ترميز، ويتجنب الشاشة السوداء بالقص على إطارات I أو بإعادة ترميز الجزء الصغير فقط. — Cuts video by stream copy without re-encoding, avoiding black starts by cutting on I-frames or re-encoding only the partial GOP.

- **كيف / how:** 1) Black or frozen first seconds = the cut started on a P/B frame; snap the in-point to the previous keyframe or use smart cut (re-encode only from the chosen frame to the next I-frame). 2) Audio plays but video freezes after export: set avoid_negative_ts make_zero. 3) Keep secondary audio, subtitles and chapters by mapping all streams (-map 0). 4) Generate cut lists with millisecond segments as project files so the edit is reproducible. **أرقام / params:** cut points, streams

- **ماذا / what:** ينشئ مشاهد After Effects بالسكربت بمواصفات محددة وأدوات تحكم قابلة لإعادة الاستخدام وطابور تصيير صريح. — Creates After Effects compositions by script with a fixed spec, reusable control rigs and an explicit render queue.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** سكربت أفتر إفكتس، قالب لوور ثيرد، أتمتة AE / After Effects script, lower third template, ExtendScript
- **كيف / how:** 1) Define width, height, frame rate and duration before any layer. 2) Expressions for procedural or linked motion; keyframes for deliberate curves. 3) Build controller nulls and parent rigs instead of hard-coding layer indices. 4) Set the output module explicitly (format, path, post-render action) and catch missing template errors. 5) Use studio-licensed fonts and check substitution; test the script against the studio's AE major version. **أرقام / params:** comp spec

#### AMEDIA-25 · تغليف الفيديو: عنوان ونص مصغّرة لا يتكرران · Video packaging: title and thumbnail text that never overlap · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يكتب عنوان الفيديو ونص الصورة المصغرة كزوج: العنوان يحمل الموضوع والكلمات المفتاحية، والمصغرة تحمل التوتر. — Writes title and thumbnail text as a pair: the title carries topic and keywords, the thumbnail carries the tension.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** عنوان يوتيوب، صورة مصغرة، ثمبنيل / YouTube title, thumbnail text, video packaging
- **كيف / how:** 1) Tag intent: search (front-load the query phrase), browse (more intrigue, the thumbnail breaks the pattern), or both (package for search, thumbnail does browse). 2) Reject any pair where a thumbnail word repeats in the title. 3) Title ≤60 characters where possible; thumbnail text 1-3 words (4 is a caption). 4) Clarity beats curiosity; never promise more than the video delivers. 5) Thumbnail: one accent colour, high contrast, a real face with a readable expression when the format calls for it, nothing that does not earn its place. 6) Always give at least three pairs or three fixes. **أرقام / params:** title ≤60 chars; thumb 1-3 words
